top_repos.portability_reason: The repo is Python tooling, but its `ir2c` templates include plain C signal objects such as biquad and delay, so the useful output is separable from the desktop design tool.
top_repos.value_reason: It adds a practical bridge from musician-friendly Pure Data prototyping to static C/C++ code for Daisy, Teensy, or STM32 targets.
top_repos.port_idea: Use hvcc offline to compile a small Pure Data synth or effect, then keep only the generated C core plus board-specific audio and parameter glue.
top_repos.note: NEW - compiler route gives firmware teams a real path from PD patches to static C/C++ DSP.
top_repos.summary: Pure Data patch compiler whose generated C/C++ path can turn desktop patch ideas into firmware-sized DSP kernels.

top_repos.portability_reason: The useful C++ DSP lives under `mwengine/src/main/cpp`, but Android drivers, Java/Kotlin API, and engine scheduling must be stripped away.
top_repos.value_reason: It offers tempo-aware sequencing, pitch-shifted sample playback, synthesis, and effect-chain architecture beyond stock embedded examples.
top_repos.port_idea: Extract one channel/effect-chain path or a small synth voice to Teensy 4.1, replacing Android I/O with a fixed audio callback.
top_repos.note: NEW - Android host code needs removal, but the MIT C++ DSP/effect core is visible.
top_repos.summary: Android-first C++ audio engine with sequencing, synthesis, channel processing, and effect-chain code.

top_repos.portability_reason: The source tree exposes modules such as `ml_chorus`, `ml_delay`, `audio_module`, and board codec headers without requiring a plugin host.
top_repos.value_reason: It gives Daisy or Teensy work a ready menu of synth blocks and board patterns rather than a single demo patch.
top_repos.port_idea: Lift oscillator/effect modules into a Daisy voice or compare its Arduino-style module API against Teensy Audio objects.
top_repos.note: NEW - embedded-friendly synth modules with current activity and concrete effect code.
top_repos.summary: Arduino synth module library with oscillator, chorus, delay, codec, and board-support code already close to embedded form.

top_repos.portability_reason: The `.dsp` files are directly inspectable, but the external pitch tracker and vocoder-style processing make a whole port too costly for a first pass.
top_repos.value_reason: A vocal-controlled synth/follower engine would add a much more distinctive embedded instrument than another oscillator-filter voice.
top_repos.port_idea: Start with one lightweight Faust follower voice on Daisy Seed, then replace or simplify pitch tracking before attempting vocoder variants.
top_repos.note: NEW - Faust source is portable, but pitch/follower processing makes this a high-value stretch.
top_repos.summary: Faust project that turns monophonic input into vocoder, FM, Karplus-Strong, and related follower synth voices.

top_repos.portability_reason: The repo carries DaisySP source in a Teensy/Pico-oriented layout, with README notes on Teensy 4.x CPU cost and optional framework use.
top_repos.value_reason: It is not novel DSP, but it is a high-value portability reference for moving Daisy-style algorithms across MCU audio stacks.
top_repos.port_idea: Use it as a regression reference when porting desktop DSP blocks into a Teensy or Pico-style callback and memory model.
top_repos.note: NEW - useful bridge evidence for DaisySP-class algorithms on Teensy 4.x and Pico 2.
top_repos.summary: Teensy 4.x and Pico 2 port of DaisySP that documents CPU expectations and embedded integration tradeoffs.

top_repos.portability_reason: The Airwindows DSP is present in individual `source/objects/...` C++ files, but Max Min wrapper code must be removed.
top_repos.value_reason: It exposes a broad shelf of reverbs, delays, filters, compressors, and saturation blocks that can be ported one at a time.
top_repos.port_idea: Choose one low-memory delay, biquad, or saturation object and rewrite the Max object boundary as a Daisy or Teensy processor class.
top_repos.note: NEW - wrapper-heavy, but per-effect C++ files make selective MCU extraction realistic.
top_repos.summary: More than 150 Airwindows-derived effects wrapped as Max/MSP externals with per-effect C++ source files.

top_repos.portability_reason: The repo includes `dsp/stone_phaser.dsp` and generated `StonePhaserDsp` files, so the effect core is easy to separate from DPF packaging.
top_repos.value_reason: A good phaser with color and feedback controls adds a compact, musically useful modulation effect beyond basic chorus/flanger blocks.
top_repos.port_idea: Compile the Faust DSP for a fixed stereo Daisy effect and map rate, depth, color, and feedback to four hardware controls.
top_repos.note: NEW - compact Faust phaser is one of the cleanest effect-port targets this week.
top_repos.summary: Small Stone-style phaser implemented in Faust with generated C++ plugin code alongside the source DSP.

top_repos.portability_reason: It already proves Faust integration on an STM32F4-class board, with `.dsp` files and hardware-facing C/C++ code in one small project.
top_repos.value_reason: Even if messy, it is a concrete reference for using Faust as the design source for MCU synth firmware.
top_repos.port_idea: Reuse the Faust-to-board integration pattern for Daisy Seed while swapping the F4 board layer for libDaisy audio and controls.
top_repos.note: NEW - messy but valuable STM32 proof that Faust synth kernels can live on small MCUs.
top_repos.summary: STM32F405 Faust synth prototype with wavetable, FM, noise, panel, and generated integration code.

top_repos.portability_reason: The code is still a JUCE plugin, but `Source/SynthEngine` separates the synth blocks enough to justify a focused extraction pass.
top_repos.value_reason: The combination of DCO voice, 4-pole ladder filter, and BBD-style chorus is a practical embedded polysynth feature set.
top_repos.port_idea: Port a mono or 2-voice subset first, dropping FFT analysis and rebuilding voice allocation and smoothing for a fixed MCU audio callback.
top_repos.note: NEW - low-star beta, but real separated synth-engine files make it more than a GUI shell.
top_repos.summary: Recent JUCE/VST3 polyphonic synth with a visible `SynthEngine` split for DCO, ADSR, ladder filter, chorus, and delay.

top_repos.portability_reason: The project is dependency-light and header-only, but C++20, SIMD, FFT, and larger effect modules need toolchain and memory triage.
top_repos.value_reason: Its clean module set could seed a compact embedded utility layer faster than extracting blocks from a plugin repo.
top_repos.port_idea: Start with `Oscillator`, `EnvelopeGenerator`, `Biquad`, `LadderFilter`, and `ProcessorChain`, leaving FFT/reverb/SIMD paths disabled until profiling.
top_repos.note: NEW - header-only MIT DSP blocks are promising if the C++20/toolchain footprint stays under control.
top_repos.summary: New MIT header-only C++20 DSP framework with filters, oscillators, envelopes, processor chains, FFT, reverb, and dynamics.
